args.message: Fix round_money to use ROUND_HALF_EVEN per FIN-212

args.body:
## Problem
The nightly build fails: `tests/test_money.py` expects banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN, per FIN-212), but `src/money.py` implements `ROUND_HALF_UP`.

## Fix
Change `round_money` to use `Decimal.quantize(..., rounding=ROUND_HALF_EVEN)` so the implementation matches both the docstring and FIN-212.

- `2.675 -> 2.68`
- `2.665 -> 2.66` (previously rounded up to 2.67)

## Verification
CI run `ci-0001` on commit `08d3cd5986` passed, including the previously failing `test_half_even`.
